citation: Sparrow, M. D., K. J. Heywood, J. Brown and D. P. Stevens (1996), Current structure of the south Indian Ocean, JGR 101(C3), 6377–6391, doi:10.1029/95JC03750.

source_identity.identity_basis: Original title page, authors, page range and DOI; repository uses Frontal structure of the Antarctic Circumpolar Current in the South Indian Ocean.
source_identity.rights: Copyright 1996 American Geophysical Union; no redistribution permission inferred. PDF and private renders remain ignored.

review_method: All fifteen scanned pages visually read. Text extraction returned zero characters per page. No figure digitization or copied table.

source_findings.finding: STF criteria use potential temperature 10–12°C and salinity 34.6–35.0 at 100 m; ARF uses potential temperature 12–16°C at 200 m.
The SAF criterion follows rapid descent of a subsurface salinity minimum.
HASO combines historical hydrography on a one-degree grid; FRAM uses a six-year model average. Geostrophic references and model surface supports differ.
FRAM assigns 41°S to STF and 44°S to SAF, with respective surface speeds 14 and 34 cm/s. HASO shows different frontal placement.
ARF identification weakens eastward; its detectable reach differs between HASO and FRAM. Stramma's SIOC terminology encompasses frontal flow and northward branches.
A northern subtropical-front feature near 33°S appears in FRAM but not HASO.
Frontal merging, branching, bathymetry, model forcing and source resolution affect the diagnosed circulation.

osw_assessment.unchanged_diagnostic_role: The frozen 15 m/1000 m gradient and velocity-candidate report remains exploratory context. No candidate becomes an identified STF, ARF, SAF or SIOC merely through a nearest-gradient match.
osw_assessment.next_decision: Inspect the complete existing source under its unchanged protocol. If applying these specific front criteria, declare additional vertical support and a temperature/salinity reference-conversion method first. Structural and regional naming ambiguity still require assessment; satisfying one property bracket cannot automatically identify the named current.
osw_assessment.no_back_revision: Do not replace the existing depths, alter frozen protocols after acquisition, treat a classification criterion as a current width, or relabel a model-year comparison as historical reproduction.
